name: call_indirect_table_entry
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer read from a global table at a fixed negative offset, then returns. It performs no other work.

name: call_then_measure_stack_string
description: Invokes a function pointer loaded from a global, then measures the length of a string in a 140-byte stack buffer by scanning to its null terminator. If the string is non-empty it passes the buffer, its length and the parameter on to a second routine.

name: copy_block_then_call_pointer
description: If the destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset within a register-held structure into it. It then calls a function pointer held in a register and returns.

name: run_setpatch_entry_point
description: Program entry point that opens the DOS library, allocates a control structure, and parses command-line text into an argument array when arguments are present, then runs the setup routine. It frees the structure and closes the library handles afterwards, returning status 20 if the allocation fails.

name: release_patch_state
description: Stores the status parameter in a patch-state structure reached through a global pointer, then conditionally calls cleanup vectors for handles, libraries and resources. It returns the stored status value.

name: run_patch_sequence_conditionally
description: Runs an unconditional setup step, then, when a global flag is nonzero, runs a step on the parameter and feeds its result to another step. It ends with a further unconditional step.

name: install_patches_from_options
description: Installs patches to system libraries and devices according to command-line options and the system version. It checks for a help query and a resident-use option, skips patches already in place, and sets global flags recording what was applied.

name: call_indirect_via_table
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer read from a global variable at a fixed offset, and returns that routine's result.

name: allocate_memory_via_exec
description: Calls the AllocMem routine through the exec base with its arguments passed through, and returns nothing.

name: call_find_task
description: Calls the FindTask routine through the exec base and discards its result. Returns no value.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Calls the CloseLibrary routine through the exec base with its arguments passed through, and returns nothing.

name: open_library_via_exec
description: Calls the OpenLibrary routine through the exec base with its arguments passed through, and returns nothing.

name: allocate_and_install_code_stub
description: Checks the memory size and flags in a global structure, then allocates a memory block of a suitable type and copies a fixed block of code from another routine into it. It stores the block address in the structure and saves the complement of a word sum over the structure, returning 0, or 20 when the checks or allocations fail.

name: store_word_sum_and_call
description: Computes the complement of a word sum over a 22-word structure field and stores it in the structure. It then calls a routine through a pointer, first advancing that pointer when a marker word at a fixed position matches a constant.

name: patch_disk_resource_functions
description: Opens the disk resource, and when its library version is below 36 it installs replacement functions with SetFunction and stores the previous function values in two globals. It keeps a nesting count in a byte and returns minus one when it patched, otherwise zero.

name: copy_word_if_call_succeeds
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer stored in a global variable. When that call returns nonzero, it copies a longword from a fixed offset in a structure into a global variable.

name: call_handler_when_value_matches
description: Returns immediately unless a stored global value equals a structure field or is minus one. In those cases it calls a routine through a function pointer held in a global variable.

name: call_handler_when_minus_one
description: Returns unless the data register holds minus one, in which case it calls a routine through a function pointer held in a global variable.

name: check_marker_and_dispatch
description: Sets a global flag, then checks a four-character marker at the start of low memory. When the marker is absent it writes the marker and two longwords, then calls one entry of a table selected by a test, and otherwise calls a different entry of the same table.

name: call_table_vector_136
description: Calls the routine at a fixed offset in a table referenced by a global pointer, then returns.

name: fill_vector_table_with_stubs
description: Stores a computed offset into a global variable, then fills sixteen consecutive table entries at a fixed low address with addresses of a routine, advancing the address by two bytes for each entry.

name: call_routine_repeatedly_return_last
description: Calls one unnamed routine in a run of consecutive calls and returns the result of the last call. The identical calls suggest a block of repeated entry points rather than separate logic.

name: call_routine_repeatedly_return_last
description: Calls one unnamed routine in a run of consecutive calls and returns the result of the last call. The identical calls suggest a block of repeated entry points rather than separate logic.

name: call_routine_repeatedly_return_last
description: Calls one unnamed routine in a run of consecutive calls and returns the result of the last call. The identical calls suggest a block of repeated entry points rather than separate logic.

name: return_input_value
description: Returns the value passed in the data register unchanged, with no other operations.

name: skip_setfunction_on_new_versions
description: Returns without action when the library version field is above 35. Otherwise it calls the SetFunction routine through the exec base.

name: allocate_entry_table_blocks
description: Allocates a block sized from a count field, then fills each slot with a value from the input and a further allocated block. If a later allocation fails, it frees the blocks obtained so far and returns an error value with its high bit set.

name: free_blocks_and_return_error
description: Frees a run of memory blocks by calling the FreeMem routine through the exec base once per remaining count plus a final time. It then returns a status value read from memory with its high bit set.

name: free_block_and_return_status
description: Calls the FreeMem routine through the exec base once and returns a status value read from memory with its high bit set.

name: return_without_action
description: Performs no work and returns immediately to its caller. It is reached through a library vector call, so it acts as an empty routine in that slot.

name: call_predicate_then_notify
description: Calls a routine through a global function pointer with a longword read from a structure. When that call returns nonzero, it calls two more routines through global pointers, passing the saved longword to the second, and returns whether the first call was nonzero.

name: scan_words_for_marker
description: Advances through an array of 16-bit words from the input pointer until it reaches a word whose high byte equals a fixed marker value, then returns a pointer to that word.

name: decode_relative_entry_pointer
description: Decodes a relative displacement from the word at the input pointer, using either its low byte or the following word, then halves and sign-extends it. It returns the pointer advanced past the encoded entry.

name: compute_word_offset
description: Reads a 16-bit word two bytes past the input pointer, halves it and sign-extends it from bit fourteen. It returns the input pointer advanced by twice that value plus two.

name: store_three_derived_pointers
description: Calls a pointer-advancing helper routine in sequence to step through a run of entries, then stores three of the returned pointers in global variables.

name: call_dispatch_routine
description: Calls the Dispatch routine of the exec library through a library base pointer held in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: pass_arguments_with_stack_pointer
description: Passes its two parameters on to another routine together with a pointer to a stack slot at a fixed offset, then returns.

name: format_and_measure_stack_text
description: Calls the RawDoFmt routine of exec through its library base, then measures the length of a 140-byte stack text buffer up to its null terminator. When that length is non-zero it passes the buffer, the length and the parameter to a second routine.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the memory location addressed by the address register, then returns.

name: run_endcli_program_setup
description: Program entry that scans a linked list for its largest value, then builds a table of incrementing longwords and a copy of a stack-held buffer. It calls a helper routine through a register pointer at each step, copies sixteen longwords between buffers, and returns zero on success or minus one when a step fails.

name: copy_block_then_call_pointer
description: If the destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset within a register-held structure into it. It then calls a function pointer held in a register and returns.

name: run_echo_program_setup

name: chain_conditional_call_results
description: When a global flag is nonzero, passes the parameter to one routine and feeds its result to a second routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: install_system_patches
description: Installs patches into the exec and layers libraries after checking the library version fields and whether the patches are already present. It reads an option letter from the command line, sets a global flag recording the result, and patches library vectors while allocating memory for the new structures.

name: reset_system_after_check
description: Writes a marker into low memory and sets an interrupt-related global flag. When the marker check and a memory test succeed it hands off to a stored routine and returns; otherwise it waits in a counted delay loop, calls the reset routine and jumps through a stored pointer.

name: set_control_value_if_negative
description: Sets a global control value to a fixed value when a longword read from a structure is negative. Otherwise it returns without changing anything.

name: install_vector_with_delay
description: Clears two memory words, sets a global control value, and stores a routine pointer at a fixed low-memory vector. It runs a counted delay loop, then either resets the system or calls a library-vector routine with the saved data register value.

name: wait_then_reset_or_call
description: Runs a counted delay loop, then calls the reset routine when a status byte test fails. Otherwise it calls a library routine at a fixed offset from a library base.

name: fetch_library_entry_and_close
description: Returns a code pointer that it obtains from a library when a state word is set. When set, it calls a formatting routine, opens a library, calls a function at a fixed offset in that library, closes it, clears a byte and marks the state as unset.

name: open_intuition_library_entry
description: Opens intuition.library and calls a function at a fixed offset from its base, then closes the library and returns that function's result. It clears a status byte and sets the state word to minus one before returning.

name: copy_string_with_null
description: Writes a zero byte at the destination, then copies a null-terminated string from the source after it, and finally writes a minus-one byte after the terminator. Returns nothing.

name: reset_after_delay
description: Runs a counted delay loop, then calls the reset routine and jumps through a stored pointer. It does not return to its caller.

name: find_fast_and_chip_blocks
description: Walks the memory block list from a global structure to find the first block inside a fixed high address range with one type tag, and the first block with another type tag below a fixed address. When both are found and differ it calls two routines with them, then calls a further routine.

name: call_forbid_via_exec
description: Calls the Forbid routine through the exec base and returns nothing.

name: call_permit_via_exec
description: Calls the Permit routine through the exec base and returns nothing.

description: Program entry for the V38 patch installer. From its argument template and text it handles the QUIET, NOCACHE and REVERSE switches, checks the library version, and applies a list of library-vector patches before reporting success or the already-installed case. The listing is cut off, so later branches are not described.

name: check_flag_then_copy_self
description: Calls a library routine and returns zero if it fails. When a flag bit in a global structure is set, it copies fifty words of its own code into an allocated block, runs cache-clearing and cache-control calls, passes the cache-control result to the Supervisor routine, and frees the block. It returns one when the flag is set.

name: copy_self_if_flag_set
description: When a flag bit in a global structure is set, copies fifty words of its own code into an allocated block and runs cache-clearing and cache-control calls around a Supervisor call, then frees the block. Returns one when the flag is set, otherwise zero.

name: copy_self_and_run_supervisor
description: Allocates a block, copies fifty words of its own code into it, and runs cache-clearing and cache-control calls around a Supervisor call. It then frees the block and returns one.

name: update_control_byte_from_probe
description: When a status byte does not hold the sentinel value, probes memory downward from a fixed high address for a self-referencing longword to select a mask. It then updates a control byte by setting its low three bits and clearing the mask, and returns nothing.

name: free_patch_table_entries
description: Clears a pointer at a fixed offset and frees it when it was set. It then walks six consecutive pointer slots, freeing each non-null one and clearing it with its companion slot, and returns one.

name: dispatch_message_by_type
description: Checks the type field of a message. When it matches one of two fixed values it updates the associated structure fields, clears a flag and replies to the message through the exec base; other types are passed to a stored routine pointer.

name: reply_to_message_by_type
description: Checks the type field of a message. When it matches one of two fixed values it updates the associated structure fields, clears a flag and replies to the message through the exec base; other types are passed to a stored routine pointer.

name: reply_to_message_type_four
description: When the message sub-field holds the value four, updates the associated structure fields, clears a flag and replies to the message through the exec base. Otherwise it passes control to a stored routine pointer.

name: reply_when_field_clear
description: When a longword at a fixed offset is zero, copies a stored value into another field, clears a flag and replies to the message through the exec base. Otherwise it passes control to a stored routine pointer.

name: call_two_setup_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns zero. The text it references names the two CIA resources.

name: service_flagged_structure
description: Fetches a structure through a library call. When its flag byte is negative, it runs three library routines on it, clears the flag and calls one more library routine. It returns the structure pointer, or the result of that last call when the flag was set.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Two-instruction routine that calls one other routine and returns. Its decompiled listing was unavailable, so no more detail is given.

name: jump_to_fixed_address
description: A single jump entry that passes control straight to a fixed address elsewhere in memory. It does no other work.

name: store_device_structure_fields
description: Calls a library routine and, when it returns a non-null structure, stores a longword from that structure and the structure pointer into two globals, and the library base into a third. Its text refers to console.device.

name: check_range_then_call_library
description: Compares a stack value with a range held in two globals. Inside the range it calls a library routine at a fixed offset and, when that succeeds, calls a further routine and a second library routine. Outside the range it calls a stored routine pointer instead.

name: call_stored_routine_pointer
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer held in a global variable and returns nothing.

name: check_limit_then_call_library
description: Compares an input value with an upper limit held in a global. Within the limit it calls a library routine at a fixed offset and, when that succeeds, calls a further routine and a second library routine. Above the limit it calls a stored routine pointer instead.

name: store_offset_from_library_result
description: Chooses one of two constant offsets depending on whether a word field equals a fixed value, then calls a library routine and, when it returns non-null, stores the result plus the offset in a global. Its text refers to dos.library.

name: clear_matching_table_entries
description: Uses the input index to look up a table slot. When the slot equals a stored value, it sets the two following slots to minus one; otherwise it calls a routine through a stored pointer.

name: clear_matching_table_entries
description: Uses the input index to look up a table slot. When the slot equals a stored value, it sets the two following slots to minus one; otherwise it calls a routine through a stored pointer.

name: clear_matching_table_entries
description: Uses the input index to look up a table slot. When the slot equals a stored value, it sets the two following slots to minus one; otherwise it calls a routine through a stored pointer.

name: call_stored_routine_pointer
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer held in a global variable and returns nothing.

name: run_three_library_steps
description: Calls three library routines in sequence, storing a fixed value in a global between the second and third, and returns one.

name: store_argument_in_global
description: Stores the address register input into a global variable and returns one.

name: record_value_and_fill_pattern
description: Calls a stored routine and records its result in a table slot chosen by the input. When the new value is a fixed sentinel and a linked entry exists, fills a fixed run of longwords in that entry with an alternating-bit pattern.

name: record_value_and_fill_pattern
description: Calls a stored routine and records its result in a table slot chosen by the input. When the new value is a fixed sentinel and a linked entry exists, fills a fixed run of longwords in that entry with an alternating-bit pattern.

name: record_value_and_fill_pattern
description: Calls a stored routine and records its result in a table slot chosen by the input. When the new value is a fixed sentinel and a linked entry exists, fills a fixed run of longwords in that entry with an alternating-bit pattern.

name: add_library_result_to_pointers
description: Calls a library routine and, when it returns non-null, adds the result into two stored address values. Its text refers to intuition.library.

name: copy_field_on_matching_event
description: When two input values match fixed constants and a flags field has bits set, copies one longword field to another. It then increments a counter byte at a fixed offset.

name: copy_field_on_matching_value
description: When a value equals a fixed constant and a flags field has bits set, copies one longword field to another. It then increments a counter byte at a fixed offset.

name: clear_flag_and_flush_cache
description: Selects a target word, obtaining it through a Supervisor call when a flag bit is set, clears the lowest bit of that word, then calls the cache-clearing routine. Returns nothing.

name: find_matching_list_node
description: Returns the input value unchanged when the address input is nonzero. Otherwise it forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field equals the input, permits again, and returns the input when a node was found or zero when none was.

name: find_matching_list_node
description: Returns the input value unchanged when the address input is nonzero. Otherwise it forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field equals the input, permits again, and returns the input when a node was found or zero when none was.

description: Returns the input value unchanged when the address input is nonzero. Otherwise it forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field equals the input, permits again, and returns the input when a node was found or zero when none was.

name: search_list_return_status_two
description: Forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field matches the input, then permits again. Returns the input when a node is found and the constant two otherwise.

name: search_list_return_status_two
description: Forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field matches the input, then permits again. Returns the input when a node is found and the constant two otherwise.

name: search_list_or_minus_one
description: Returns minus one when the input is minus one. Otherwise it forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field matches the input, permits again, and returns the input when a node is found or minus one when none is.

name: search_list_or_minus_one
description: Returns minus one when the input is minus one. Otherwise it forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field matches the input, permits again, and returns the input when a node is found or minus one when none is.

name: find_matching_list_node
description: Forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field matches the input, then permits again. Returns the input when a node is found and zero otherwise.

name: find_matching_list_node
description: Forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field matches the input, then permits again. Returns the input when a node is found and zero otherwise.

name: find_list_node_return_argument
description: Forbids multitasking, searches a linked list for a node whose short field matches the input, then permits again. It returns the input value when the node is found, otherwise the first parameter.

name: permit_and_select_argument
description: Calls the Permit routine through the exec base, then returns the stack argument when the address input is nonzero, otherwise the third parameter.

name: scan_table_and_clear_cache
description: Selects a table pointer, obtaining it through a Supervisor call when a flag bit is set, then scans forward through 16-bit words until one equals a fixed value and stores that position. It calls the cache-clearing routine and returns one.

name: call_pointer_unless_marker
description: Compares the word at a stored address with a fixed marker value. When it differs, it calls a routine through that stored pointer; when it matches, it calls this routine again.

name: call_pointer_unless_marker
description: Compares the word at a stored address with a fixed marker value. When it differs, it calls a routine through that stored pointer; when it matches, it calls this routine again.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns. It does no other work.

name: copy_string_into_allocated_vector
description: When a library call succeeds, measures a string from the input pointer, allocates a vector to hold it, and copies it in with a length byte before the text and a terminator after. It passes the buffer to a routine and returns that result, or frees the vector and returns zero when allocation fails.

name: copy_length_prefixed_string
description: Measures a string, copies it into a buffer with a length byte placed before the text, adds a terminator, and calls a routine through a pointer in a register-held table.

name: copy_counted_bytes_backwards
description: Copies a counted run of bytes backwards from one buffer into another, stores a length byte before them, adds a terminator, and calls a routine through a register-held table entry.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: call_routine_return_register_pair
description: Calls a library routine through a fixed offset and returns the values left in the two data registers as a 64-bit result.

name: decrement_count_and_release_entries
description: Increments a counter byte, then decrements a count field in the input structure. When that count reaches zero it walks a linked list and calls one routine for each flagged entry, then calls Permit through the exec base; when the count is negative it calls Alert and InitSemaphore instead.

name: alert_or_decrement_count
description: When the negative flag is set, calls Alert and InitSemaphore through the exec base; otherwise decrements a count word in the input structure. It then calls Permit through the exec base.

name: alert_and_init_semaphore
description: Calls Alert and InitSemaphore through the exec base, then calls Permit, and returns nothing.

name: release_list_entries_and_permit
description: Moves the first entry from a linked list in the input structure and, while entries carry a flag, calls a routine through a library offset for each one. It then calls Permit through the exec base.

name: walk_list_and_permit
description: Walks a linked list from a pointer in the input structure, unlinking each entry and calling a library routine at a fixed offset for every entry until the list ends. It then calls Permit through the exec base.

name: increment_count_and_permit
description: Increments a counter byte and a count word in the input structure. When the count is nonzero and a pointer field is set, it clears a bit in a stored structure, calls two library routines and calls Permit; otherwise it increments a second field and calls Permit.

name: clear_bit_and_permit
description: When a pointer field in the input structure is set, clears one flag bit in a stored structure, calls two library routines and calls Permit. Otherwise it increments a count word and calls Permit.

name: call_handler_outside_range
description: Calls a stored routine and returns its byte result when the stack pointer lies outside a range recorded in a library structure or a flag field equals minus one. Otherwise it returns the input byte unchanged.

name: call_handler_outside_range
description: Calls a stored routine when the stack pointer lies outside a range recorded in a library structure or a flag field equals minus one; otherwise it returns without action.

name: call_handler_outside_range
description: Calls a stored routine and returns its byte result when the stack pointer lies outside a range recorded in a library structure or a flag field equals minus one. Otherwise it returns the input byte unchanged.

name: call_handler_outside_range
description: Calls a stored routine when the stack pointer lies outside a range recorded in a library structure or a flag field equals minus one; otherwise it returns without action.

name: store_arguments_return_one
description: Stores the address register input in one global variable and the library base register in another, then returns one.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine. Its decompiled listing was unavailable, so no more detail is given.

name: stub_listing_unavailable
description: Its decompiled listing could not be produced. From its instructions it calls one other routine and a small merge routine, and no further detail is recoverable.

name: run_version_entry_point
description: Program entry point that opens the DOS library, allocates a control structure, and parses command-line text into an argument array when arguments are present, then runs the setup routine. It frees the structure and closes the library handles afterwards, returning status 20 if the allocation fails.

name: release_patch_state
description: Stores the status parameter in a patch-state structure reached through a global pointer, then conditionally calls cleanup vectors for handles, libraries and resources. It returns the stored status value.

name: check_library_version
description: Parses command-line arguments to open a named library or device, then compares its version and revision with the user's thresholds and the Kickstart and Workbench versions. It prints usage and error messages from its text when arguments are wrong or the open fails.

name: call_two_helpers_with_flag
description: Calls one routine with its first argument and the constant 128, then calls another routine with its second argument. It returns nothing.

name: parse_integer_string
description: Parses a decimal integer from a string, skipping an optional plus or minus sign and then reading digits, and applies the sign to the result.

name: compare_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte. Returns minus one when the first is smaller at the first difference, one when it is greater, and zero when the strings are equal.

name: calculate_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a null-terminated string up to, but not including, the terminator, and returns that length.

name: call_reschedule_routine
description: Calls the Reschedule routine through the exec base and returns nothing.

name: call_dispatch_routine
description: Calls the Dispatch routine of the exec library through a library base pointer held in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: pass_arguments_with_stack_pointer
description: Passes its two parameters on to another routine together with a pointer to a stack slot at a fixed offset, then returns.

name: allocate_memory_via_exec
description: Calls the AllocMem routine through the exec base with its arguments passed through, and returns nothing.

name: free_memory_via_exec
description: Calls the FreeMem routine through the exec base with its arguments passed through, and returns nothing.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Calls the CloseLibrary routine through the exec base with its arguments passed through, and returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_444
description: Calls a library routine at a fixed offset from a library base held in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_450
description: Calls a library routine at a fixed offset from a library base held in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: open_library_via_exec
description: Calls the OpenLibrary routine through the exec base with its arguments passed through, and returns nothing.

name: format_and_measure_stack_text
description: Calls the RawDoFmt routine of exec through its library base, then measures the length of a 140-byte stack text buffer up to its null terminator. When that length is non-zero it passes the buffer, the length and the parameter to a second routine.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the memory location addressed by the address register, then returns.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only undecodable instruction data, so no routine behaviour can be recovered. Decompilation stops at its first instruction.

name: run_wing_commander_installer
description: Installer entry that runs a sequence of unnamed calls, then calls FreeMem through the exec base in a loop. Afterwards it clears a longword and, when a field matches a fixed bit pattern, saves that entry and clears a global. It returns a 64-bit value from the data registers.

name: decrement_counter_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit register counter in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns. It is a counted delay and does nothing else.

name: run_wing_program_entry
description: Program entry that runs a sequence of unnamed calls, then calls FreeMem through the exec base in a loop. Afterwards it clears a longword and, when a field matches a fixed bit pattern, saves that entry and clears a global. It returns a 64-bit value from the data registers.

name: decrement_counter_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit register counter in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns. It is a counted delay and does nothing else.

name: unpack_bitstream_with_runs
description: Decodes a bit stream read backwards from the input, using variable-length run lengths to copy previously written data into the output over four passes. It clears the cache afterwards when the library version is above 36.

name: decode_backward_bitstream_block
description: Continues the backward bit-stream decoding by reading run-length codes and copying earlier output into the destination, using a table of length bases.

name: copy_decoded_runs_to_output
description: Decodes backward bit-stream run lengths and copies earlier output into the destination for each run, using a length table. It is one of the decoder's continuation blocks.

name: decode_longword_runs_to_output
description: Decodes backward bit-stream run lengths and writes the output in four-byte steps, copying earlier output in longword groups. It returns the last written longword when the output is complete.

name: check_bounds_then_trap
description: Stores a byte, rotates a word at a fixed offset, then checks an index against a bound and raises a bounds-check trap when it is out of range. The following bytes are bad instruction data, so decoding stops here.

name: return_minus_one
description: Returns minus one in the data register and does nothing else.

name: store_hook_and_call_table
description: Calls routines through a structure pointer held in a register, stores a routine address and the structure pointer into two globals, then makes two further structure-table calls and a call through a global pointer.

name: patch_jump_if_matched
description: Calls a routine from a table at a fixed offset and compares its short result with two fixed values. When it matches, it writes a call instruction targeting this routine into one of two fixed fields of a structure, then calls a further routine. Otherwise it returns without action.

name: save_struct_field_around_call
description: Copies a longword from a fixed offset in a structure into a global, calls a routine through a stored structure table entry, then stores the data register word into a global.

name: save_second_field_around_call
description: Copies a longword from another fixed offset in a structure into a global, calls a routine through a stored structure table entry, then stores the data register word into a global.

name: call_table_entry_conditionally
description: Calls a routine through a stored structure table entry, then calls it again when a global flag is nonzero.

name: handle_flag_then_call_table
description: Tests a byte flag in the data register. When the flag is zero or negative it writes back a word and, if the test still holds, returns the input with a fixed bit mask applied. Otherwise it calls two table routines and returns the result of a final call through a global pointer.

name: write_word_and_call_table
description: Writes back a word at a fixed offset. When the data register flag is zero or negative it returns the input with a fixed bit mask applied; otherwise it calls two table routines and returns the result of a final call through a global pointer.

name: write_word_and_call_table
description: Writes back a word at a fixed offset. When the data register flag is zero or negative it returns the input with a fixed bit mask applied; otherwise it calls two table routines and returns the result of a final call through a global pointer.

name: rewrite_word_at_offset
description: Rewrites the 16-bit value at a fixed offset before the address input with the same value, then returns.

name: rewrite_word_at_offset
description: Rewrites the 16-bit value at a fixed offset before the address input with the same value, then returns.

name: store_hook_and_call_table
description: Calls routines through a structure pointer held in a register, stores a routine address and the structure pointer into two globals, then makes two further structure-table calls and a call through a global pointer.

name: call_unresolved_jump_pointer
description: Calls through a pointer whose target could not be recovered from the listing, then returns.
